names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 16 august.

Read out of saint.gr's line for 16 Αυγούστου, «Όσιος Γεράσιμος ο νέος ασκητής, που ασκήτευσε στη νήσο Κεφαλληνία», with the rank word, the epithet and the clause naming the island left off. The page glosses the name from γέρας, the prize, as the triumphant one.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 20. октобар ст. ст., „Преп. Герасим Нови.“ — «Преп.» is the `venerable` grade this corpus keeps in `types` and comes off, leaving the bare name with the epithet the heading prints, «Нови», the New. The epithet is kept because section 6 asks for the fullest form the calendar gives and because the bare «Герасим» is already held in sr by `gerasimus-of-the-jordan`, with seventeen Gerasimus folders in the corpus behind it. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Герасим Нови».

birth.note: Охридски пролог: «Рођен 1509. год.» The folder held no birth before this reading.

death.note: Kept unchanged. The Охридски пролог confirms it and adds the day: «Упокојио се у Господу 15. августа 1579. год.» — which is also why the Romanian and Greek calendars keep him on 16 August while this book keeps him on the Julian 20 October.

feast.note: Doxologia keeps him twice: its calendar prints him on 16 august and again on 20 octombrie — «Sfântul Cuvios Gherasim din Kefalonia». One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row is the day this folder was read from and the second day is recorded here. Both days link the same doxologia page. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 16 august — «Sfântul Cuvios Gherasim din Kefalonia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Γεράσιμος ο νέος ασκητής, που ασκήτευσε στη νήσο Κεφαλληνία»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Its head line reads «Οσιος Γερασιμος ο Νεος Ασκητης, Που Ασκητευσε Στη Νησο Κεφαλληνια (1509 - 1579)», which confirms the folder's 1579 and adds a year of birth the Romanian source did not give, 1509. **The page explains the two days, exactly as doxologia does, and the explanation is why this row records 16 August: «Ο Όσιος Γεράσιμος απεβίωσε την 15η Αυγούστου του έτους 1579 μ.Χ., αλλά επειδή την ήμερα αυτή πανηγυρίζετε η μνήμη της Κοιμήσεως της Θεοτόκου, τελείται η γιορτή του την 20ή Οκτωβρίου, τότε που έγινε η ανακομιδή του θαυματουργού λειψάνου του. Την ήμερα αυτή όμως, αναγράφηκε η μνήμη της κοιμήσεως του και γίνεται στην Κεφαλονιά μεγάλο πανηγύρι» — he died on 15 August 1579, but because the Dormition is kept that day his feast is celebrated on 20 October, when the translation of his wonderworking relic took place; on this day, however, the memory of his repose is written down, and a great festival is held in Kefalonia. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the row is the day page read, 16 Αυγούστου, and the 20 October day and the 15 August repose stand in this note and in the life. Named in the reader's report.** It calls him the patron of Kefalonia, «Πολιούχος: Κεφαλονιά», and says his relic lies incorrupt in the monastery of Omala on the island that bears his name. The folder's 1579 stands; no birth date is proposed here from the head line alone. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints no apolytikion and no kontakion, so no hymn is added.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 02.11.2025 (20. октобар ст. ст.) — „Преп. Герасим Нови.“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4). «Преп.» is the `venerable` this folder holds, and «Чудотворац» at the end of the entry the `wonderworker`; `hieromonk` and `hermit` come from its other books and this entry does not contradict them, so `types` is untouched. The URL year is 2025 and not 2026, because `sr-civil.mjs` knows that pravoslavno.rs serves the Julian 10-20 to 12-18 only on the previous civil year — the Prologue is a fixed annual cycle and a day in the past serves as well as one ahead. This is the first day of this range to need it. THE PROLOGUE KEEPS HIM ON A DIFFERENT DAY FROM THE OTHER TWO BOOKS, AND SAYS WHY WITHOUT MEANING TO. doxologia and saint.gr both keep him on 16 August; this book keeps him on the Julian 20 October AND GIVES HIS DEATH AS 15 AUGUST. So the August day of the other two calendars is the day of his death and the October day is this calendar’s own; each row stands on its own church and nothing was moved. ONE DATE ADDED. The folder held `death` 1579 and NO BIRTH. This entry says «Рођен 1509. год.», so `birth` is now 1509, attested, and the death is confirmed to the day: «Упокојио се у Господу 15. августа 1579. год.» matches the 1579 already on file. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS. He was FROM TRIKALA IN THE PELOPONNESE, OF THE FAMOUS NOTARAS FAMILY; he struggled ON ATHOS, then IN PALESTINE, WHERE HE FASTED FORTY DAYS; then settled on the island of Kefalonia, WHERE HE FOUNDED A WOMEN’S MONASTERY. And three gifts: HE BROUGHT DOWN RAIN BY PRAYER, healed the sick, and SAW INTO THE FUTURE. A wonderworker in his life and after his death. NO `related`, AND ONE NAME DELIBERATELY NOT LINKED: the corpus holds `macarius-notaras`, and a family name is not a relation — nothing read here says the two men are kin, and the Notaras of Trikala in the Peloponnese is a house and not a person. No `office`, no `locations`: Trikala, Athos, Palestine and Kefalonia are named and none is a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Vieţuitor al pustiului, ocrotitor al ortodocşilor şi înger în trup, vindecător şi de Dumnezeu purtător te-ai arătat nouă. Pentru aceasta noi, credincioşii, te lăudăm pe tine, dumnezeiescule Gherasim, că în chip vrednic ai dobândit de la Dumnezeu tămăduiri şi harul veşnic, şi îi vindeci pe cei bolnavi, pe demoni îi alungi, iar celor ce te cinstesc pe tine le izvorăşti tămăduiri. Vlăstar dumnezeiesc al Peloponesului şi comoară neprădată a Kefaloniei, lauda cea mare a întregii Elade, Sfinte Gherasim de Dumnezeu purtătorule, ocroteşte pe robii tăi!

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Gherasim Kefalonitul», Glas 4

english.text: Dweller of the wilderness, protector of the Orthodox and angel in the flesh, you were shown to us a healer and a bearer of God. Therefore we the faithful praise you, divine Gerasimus, for worthily you received from God healings and everlasting grace; you heal the sick, you drive out the demons, and on those who honour you you pour forth healings. Divine shoot of the Peloponnese and unplundered treasure of Kefalonia, great boast of all Hellas, holy God-bearing Gerasimus, protect your servants!
